key.name: idle-brightness
key.summary: Percentage to dim to when idle

key.summary: Seconds of inactivity on AC before the sleep action fires; 0 = never

key.name: sleep-inactive-battery-timeout

key.name: sleep-inactive-battery-type
key.summary: Action taken on battery idle timeout (nothing, suspend, hibernate, shutdown)
